beds.label: beds
beds.does: housed when sleeping here, one a bed

hand mill.label: a hand mill
hand mill.does: grinding grain by hand into meal (porridge, not bread)

granary.label: a granary floor
granary.does: grain keeps longest, raised and dry (300)

fire ring.label: a fire ring
fire ring.does: a fire in the open for warmth and cooking (burns timber)

cellar.label: a cellar
cellar.does: food keeps at a quarter of the house rate (40 a space of the building's ground)

millstones.label: dressed millstones
millstones.does: an ox mill: an ox turns them (D2-61)

water wheel.label: a water wheel and leat
water wheel.does: a water mill: the river turns the millstones (D2-61)

stalls.label: stalls
stalls.does: beasts housed in winter, one a stall: less fodder, dung kept, not driven off without coming in

woodshed.label: a woodshed
woodshed.does: a lean-to against the building: 40 timber kept dry

vault.label: a vault
vault.does: a stone room of its own on the ground floor: 30 weight a space kept, safe from fire (D2-49)

small room.label: a small room (wattle, timber or stone)

medium room.label: a medium room (timber on stone, or stone)

hall.label: a hall (timber on stone, or stone)

camp.label: a camp (a lean-to and a fire ring)

heavy rain.words: heavy rain, the ground running with water

fog.words: a thick fog lying on the land

gale.words: a gale tearing at the roofs
